ground_truth.label: human-annotated
purpose: calibration and selective prediction on real customer-support messages
comparison between judges on the same rows
caveats: public since 2020: probably in the pretraining data of the judges audited

one label per query from the dataset's authors, no published inter-annotator agreement; Ying & Thomas (2022) estimate that about 14 % of the train split may be mislabelled, and the test split's label noise is measured by a relabelled sample
the options are the dataset's label names without definitions; some names mislead (get_physical_card also holds questions about the PIN)
7 of 3080 test texts also appear in the train split (case and whitespace ignored); _meta.text_in_train marks them
